answer: The mesa counter is kept in ferrous and pearl publishes each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4828 identities would post 1102 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
